content:
maya: heads up — dashboard showing weird P95 inversion for /v1/generate in EU region after yesterday's routing-gateway change. p50 looks fine, p95 jumped ~40ms, p99 unchanged. anyone else see this?

ev an: can you paste the dashboard slice? is this per-client or global endpoint slice? :thinking:

maya: global endpoint slice for now. filter by client-id doesn't change shape. sample count dropped by ~20%. snapshot: `p50=45ms, p95=210ms (was 170), p99=310ms`

evan: ok two quick asks: 1) check telemetry sample_origin and sample_rate for the route 2) query raw traces for a 5m window. i suspect gateway started tagging some requests as "quota-burst" and they got sampled differently.

ravi: fyi our telemetry gateway does reservoir sampling pre-aggregation for high-throughput routes. if tags are added after sampling, percentile provenance flips. i hit this before with the quota-proxy.

maya: how do we check if tags are added after sampling? ops-bot, any logs?

ops-bot: deploy: telemetry-gateway v2.4.1 rolled at 2026-03-18T03:12:22Z by henry. Logs: `WARN tagger: late-annotate request_id=abc123 route=/v1/generate reason=quota-burst`

henry: that WARN is from the new async tagger we shipped to avoid blocking. it annotates requests after sample decision. we debated doing it sync but kept it async for latency.

evan: that's the issue — async tagger changes the provenance of sampled buckets. the dashboard rollup doesn't reclassify samples post-tag, so P95 can shift when the tagged subset has different latency.

maya: suggested quick mitigation? we have on-call for a customer demo in 30m.

ravi: short-term: revert async tag enrichment for that route or force sample by-tag at gateway (make sampler look at raw headers before async). i can open a hotfix PR for forcing sync tagging for /v1/generate.

evan: alternative quick fix: mark the dashboard to include 'sample_origin=raw' (if we have that column) so current rollups use pre-tag sample. will suppress client-level breakout though.

henry: rolling back async will add ~2ms p50 overhead, but seems safest for demo. i'll push revert to canary and watch staging.

maya: please also add an annotation on the dashboard explaining the provenance change so PMs don't misinterpret the spike.
evan: (typo) ravi: ack and PR opened: https://git.internal/r/telemetry-gateway/pulls/1422 — changes: sync-tag-for-route `/v1/generate` and a feature-flag `sync_tagging_routes`.

evan: after revert we should run: `curl -s "https://telemetry.internal/api/aggregate?route=/v1/generate&window=5m&provenance=pre_sample" | jq .` to validate counts match previous baseline.

maya: will do once canary finishes. also file a follow-up to rethink sampling position: move sampler after routing but before enrichment, or copy header-based attributes into sampler sync path.

ops-bot: canary deploy success: telemetry-gateway v2.4.2 canary on eu-west-1 (3 pods) at 5198765439

henry: canary shows p95 back to ~168ms. p50 +2ms. rolling to 30% now.

maya: excellent. create a short postmortem blurb for dashboards channel and note the root cause: async enrichment causing sample provenance mismatch. also add an UX note: dashboard should surface sample_provenance on percentile widgets.

evan: agreed — we should expose provenance and sample_count on hover and include whether aggregation used pre/post tags. will propose a small console change.

ravi: long-term: consider tagging copy-on-write so sampler has deterministic view. also add unit tests in telemetry-sim that simulate late tags.

maya: thanks all. happy path for demo restored. we'll follow up on the console UX change in next planning. :white_check_mark:
